name: Ceithlenn

attributes.attribute: a variant spelling of the name Caitlin
borne by the personification of Ireland
an Irish form of the name Catherine

text: Ceithlenn is a spelling variant of the Irish name Caitlin. Ceithlionn is another form of that same name. Caitlin itself serves as an Irish equivalent of Catherine. Since the 1100s, many people in Ireland have carried it. Folklore best remembers the figure Caitlin Ní hUallacháin. Her surname appears in varied spellings across Kilkenny, Clare, and other regions. She has come to stand for Ireland only in recent times. The 1902 play Cathleen ni Houlihan by W. B. Yeats shaped that image strongly. Within it, the Poor Old Woman presents her own story.

okr.objective: Present Ceithlenn as a spelling of Caitlin, an Irish form of Catherine tied to the personification of Ireland.
key_results: Names Ceithlenn and Ceithlionn as variant spellings of Caitlin
States Caitlin is an Irish form of Catherine in use since the twelfth century
Identifies Caitlin Ní hUallacháin as the best-known folkloric bearer
Places her family name under many spellings from Kilkenny to Clare
Links the personification of Ireland to the 1902 play Cathleen ni Houlihan by W. B. Yeats
